outcome_statement: A real, callable Overlay Action service parses natural-language commands into deterministic, auditable plans, gates risky actions (submit/delete/purchase/pay/confirm) behind explicit confirmation, and executes plans as a pure function of an already-connected page -- no browser session management of its own.
pain: Saying 'do it' has no deterministic, auditable path to actual multi-step action -- no shared way to turn a command into a plan and gate the risky parts behind real confirmation.
value: Trust that the system never takes an irreversible action without explicit confirmation, while still executing the safe parts of a command automatically.
success_metrics: parseCommand/resolveSelector/approvePlan/executePlan match the proven prototype's (scripts/prototype-overlay-action-v4.mjs, 10/10 tests) exact behavior -- a risky action never gets approved:true without an explicit stop/confirmation
failure_metrics: A risky action approved without explicit stop/confirmation
constraints: BuilderOS system path only -- no agent hand-build
Depends on V1-V3 being real (perception/contracts) per blueprint order
unacceptable_result: A risky action auto-approved without confirmation; reinvented parsing logic that doesn't match the proven prototype; live browser-agent wiring (out of scope)
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision — Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff — corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
